subject.title: fix(brave): resolve env secret refs for search key

question: Should an explicitly configured but unavailable Brave SecretRef intentionally suppress the existing ambient `BRAVE_API_KEY` fallback for upgraded installations?
rationale: The patch implements a coherent shared-resolver contract, but choosing fail-closed precedence changes the behavior of an existing fallback path and is a compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Accept fail-closed precedence
options.body: Merge after the current head is refreshed, treating an explicit configured SecretRef as authoritative even when it cannot resolve.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Change the shared or Brave-specific policy so an unavailable configured SecretRef may still use `BRAVE_API_KEY`, then adjust the regression tests and document the contract.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed precedence
recommendation.body: Merge after the current head is refreshed, treating an explicit configured SecretRef as authoritative even when it cannot resolve.

likelyOwner.reason: The patch author has the most direct current context for the intended resolver behavior and proof, though a code owner should make the final policy decision.
